comments.author: theasianpianist
comments.body: So a quick comment on these tests, the cases involving active ToR BGP shutdown are actually expected to fail/not switchover since this functionality was not implemented. I believe it was up for discussion when I first wrote the test plan, but we decided not to implement it.

comments.author: vaibhavhd
comments.body:
> So a quick comment on these tests, the cases involving active ToR BGP shutdown are actually expected to fail/not switchover since this functionality was not implemented. I believe it was up for discussion when I first wrote the test plan, but we decided not to implement it.

As discussed this functionality still is expected to fail, but needs implementation and discussion about how to handle it.
At this point, I am letting the testcase be there and fail (as expected).
